specs.title: [FILES-AC-004] browser part: an upload and a download attempted from an unrelated origin are rejected by the browser
[FILES-AC-006] browser part: an upload interrupted mid-way fails with FILES.TRANSFER_FAILED and an 'interrupted after n bytes' message
[HTTP-AC-006] api sends the session cookie
[HTTP-AC-006] api throws ApiError with the server's code on an error response
[HTTP-AC-006] api throws HTTP.NETWORK_ERROR when the API is unreachable
[HTTP-AC-006] a stubbed 502 HTML response throws HTTP.NETWORK_ERROR with that status, null requestId and the not-from-the-app message
[HTTP-AC-006] a non-JSON 200 throws HTTP.NETWORK_ERROR with that status, null requestId and the not-from-the-app message
[FILES-AC-003] expired-ticket clause: an expired ticket fails with FILES.TRANSFER_FAILED, storage's status and a rejected by storage (HTTP n) message without storage's error body
[FILES-AC-003] a 20 MB file uploads through uploadFile and downloads through downloadUrl byte-exact
[FILES-AC-003] a ticket for one name cannot write another
[FILES-AC-003] an upload with a content type other than the ticket's is rejected and stores nothing
[FILES-AC-003] uploadFile rejects a Blob whose non-empty type differs from the ticket's before sending: FILES.TRANSFER_FAILED, status null, content type does not match ticket
[FILES-AC-004] browser part: an upload and a download attempted from an unrelated origin are rejected by the browser
[FILES-AC-006] browser part: an upload interrupted mid-way fails with FILES.TRANSFER_FAILED and an interrupted after n bytes message

[DEMO-AC-002] each cell of the permissions table with mock identities (anonymous, user, another user, admin): permitted actions succeed through the page, forbidden ones are refused by the app and change nothing
[DEMO-AC-004] a banner an admin sets through the page appears at the top of the page for anonymous visitors; a user's attempt to set it is refused and changes nothing
[DEMO-AC-005] a user's posts-per-page choice, made through the page, is still the choice after logging out and in again (same browser and a new one); another user keeps the default
[DEMO-AC-007] a share link created through the page shows the draft to an anonymous visitor; the same link with one character altered is refused and shows nothing of the draft
[DEMO-AC-007] expiry clause (local, in-process with a moved clock): with the share-link lifetime configured to 1 day, a link opens after 12 hours and is refused after 2 days
[DEMO-AC-008] publishing a post and deleting it through the page each produce an info entry of the demo, written during that request, in the target's log
[DEMO-AC-003] file-deletion failure clause (local, in-process with files unavailable): deleting a post still deletes it, and the demo writes a warn entry during that request

specs.title: [DEMO-AC-011] every committed production values file sets framework.users; in-process with the stub login provider, a login on the users list creates a draft and a login on neither list is refused with 401 and sees only published posts
[CHECK-AC-005] demo part: verify passes on a fresh copy of apps/demo (portability rules, migration checker, type checking and the app's tests)
[DEMO-AC-006] changing the site title in the values file and rebuilding (restarting dev) changes the title the page displays

[DEMO-AC-001] a post title containing <script>…</script> shows as literal text to its author and, published, to an anonymous visitor in the list and on the post; no script element is added and the script does not run
[DEMO-AC-003] a JPEG of at least 20 MB attached through the page displays: an image on the post is complete with naturalWidth > 0, at the photo's size
[DEMO-AC-009] with clipboard permissions granted, the account page's copy button puts exactly the /api/auth/me user ID on the clipboard

[E2E-001][LOCAL-AC-001] a scaffolded app installs the framework from a packed tarball at an exact version, imports every public subpath, works through the template's pages under dev, and passes verify, with no credentials and no network
[E2E-003] verify fails on each of the nine portability violations, naming the rule and the skill reference to read
[E2E-002][DEMO-AC-010] local part: the demo's smoke test passes locally against dev, from a copy identical to the commit's apps/demo (no source changes)
[E2E-004] coverage part: every criterion and scenario applicable on this target has a tagged test in the suite this run executes
[E2E-004] record part: the evidence writer accepts a record of this target and rejects an invalid one
[E2E-007] local part: a user whose ID is copied from the account page into the admin list is admin after the rebuild and not before

[E2E-009] upload a 20 MB and a 100 MB photo from a real browser, view and download them byte-identical; app browser code used only the app's API and framework helpers; no storage or CORS settings in the app
[E2E-011] app and framework entries are stored under the app and stage with timestamps, and the plain-Error request's entry is found by its requestId
[E2E-011] local part: with an injected failing log writer the app still works
[E2E-013] invalid input, unauthenticated, forbidden, unknown route and plain-Error requests get catalogue errors with no stack traces, provider messages or secret values
[E2E-014] the stage reports exactly its committed configuration values
[E2E-014] local part: a configuration change takes effect only after the rebuild, and a secret set with the CLI appears nowhere scanned
[E2E-016] scan part: the term list file holds exactly the scenario's terms
[E2E-016] scan part: the scanner finds each term in identifiers, string literals and comments, case-sensitively and by whole word
[E2E-016] scan part: no app-facing contract contains a provider or protocol term
